name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + audio domain + sfx_enabled_flag descriptor correctly reflects both purpose (SE/SFX on-off setting) and datatype (boolean flag). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: User-settable SE (sound effects) on/off option flag; when 0 all one-shot SFX playback is silently suppressed.
logic_summary: 1-byte boolean. Toggled by the SE entry (menu slot 1) in fd2_game_options_menu_loop (label 0x14 ON / 0x15 OFF; flipped via conditional set). Read as one of three gates by both SFX players fd2_play_sfx_with_handle (0x25ab1) and fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank (0x25b60): playback proceeds only if sfx_driver_available(0x53EF1)!=0 && sfx_enabled(0x51E62)!=0 && cinematic/terrain idx(0x540FF==terrain)==0; otherwise no-op. Also read by fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade(0x25a3a) and fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch(0x1a0d7). Persisted in FD2.SAV: written into slot byte +0xA09 by fd2_save_current_state_to_slot (0x30109/save) and restored from +0xA09 by fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot (0x3033f), and restored from save-header byte +0x30D4 by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (0x1043e); also written by fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher (0x26090).
datatype: uint8 (1-byte boolean flag; Ghidra type undefined1, len 1)
element_semantics: Boolean: 1 = SE/sound-effects enabled (default ship value), 0 = disabled (SFX players become no-ops). Accessed only via !=0 / ==0 tests, conditional set, and single-byte save/load.
